anchor.statement: Proposition 7.2. Fix α ∈ R , a finite set of harmonics 0 < |m| ≤ M, and a label at level i on a common torus H = Y i 0 , with i − i 0 bounded as in Lemma 6.2. For each harmonic, let f m (x ∗ , H) ∈ C3 be a coefficient descending to H, smooth on the fixed enlargement of that label’s rectangles. Assume that it has a fixed closed slow support contained in the label’s slow support, a compact transverse support contained in supp χg , and support in the closed active shell X a ≤ X ≤ X b , with smooth zero extension across all these support boundaries. Assume also that on X a < X < X b and 0 ≤ v ≤ L s , for every fixed multi-index I of derivatives in (R, Z, T, H), |D I f m | ≤ C I ε αS b I ∗ √︁ ζ δ −a IP(v).

correspondence.by: Christian Garry (drafted with Claude Code; second review by ChatGPT, checked)
correspondence.note: The clauses are stated about different objects: the W_α class, (7.5) with (7.13), tangency and the ε^{1/2} pressure gain for copySolve under energy and jet hypotheses; uniqueness for anchoredSolve along one path; descent to H for the periodized commonVelocity/commonPressure; one-sided derivatives at τ = 0 for commonVelocity/commonPressure; and the energy and jet inputs from referenceControl for one harmonic j on the phase patch of a PhaseConstruction. Identifying these as one solution (real and imaginary solves, copies, periodization), and reading 'q∗ does not depend on M, α, or the correction stage' from the fact that the phase patch is fixed before j and α, is the reviewer's argument; no declaration states the proposition as one statement.

  [inst_3 : InnerProductSpace ℝ H] [inst_4 : CompleteSpace H] {L S K μ w : ℝ} (hL : 0 < L),
  1 ≤ S →
    1 ≤ K →
      0 ≤ μ →
        0 ≤ w →
          L ≤ K * S →
            Real.exp (μ * L) ≤ K →
              ∀ {U : Set Q},
                Convex ℝ U →
                  UniqueDiffOn ℝ U →
                    ∀ (A : Q × ℝ → H →L[ℝ] H),
                      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) A (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
                        ∀ (P rate : ℝ → ℝ),
                          (∀ (t : ℝ), 0 < P t) →
                            (∀ (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt P (rate t * P t) t) →
                              ∀ (f : Q × ℝ → H),
                                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
                                  ∀ {p : Q},
                                    p ∈ U →
                                      p ∈ closure (interior U) →
                                        ∀ {t : ℝ},
                                          t ∈ Set.Icc 0 L →
                                            (∀ q ∈ interior U,
                                                ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L,
                                                  ∀ (x : H), inner ℝ x ((A (q, v)) x) ≤ (rate v + μ) * ‖x‖ ^ 2) →
                                              ∀ (m N : ℕ),
                                                (∀ q ∈ interior U,
                                                    ∀ j ≤ N,
                                                      ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j A (q, v)‖ ≤ K * S ^ m) →
                                                  (∀ q ∈ interior U,
                                                      ∀ j ≤ N,
                                                        ∀ v ∈ Set.Icc 0 L,
                                                          ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f (q, v)‖ ≤ w * K * S ^ m * P v) →
                                                    ∀ j ≤ N,
                                                      ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ j
                                                            (NavierStokes.JointODE.actualSolution ⋯ A (fun (x : Q) => 0)
                                                              f)
                                                            (U ×ˢ Set.Icc 0 L) (p, t)‖ ≤
                                                        w *
                                                              (2 ^ (N + 1) *
                                                                  NavierStokes.PrimaryPulseBounds.rescaleConstant N K ^
                                                                    3) ^
                                                                (j + 1) *
                                                            S ^ ((m + 2) * (j + 1)) *
                                                          P t

exact.text:
∀ {P : Type} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup P] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ P]
  (t : NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.TangentData P NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space)
  (f : P × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane → NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.ComplexVector)
  (g : NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.Geometry) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b) {U : Set P},
  Convex ℝ U →
    UniqueDiffOn ℝ U →
      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) t.normal (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
        ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) t.normalDot (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) t.action (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) t.damping (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f (U ×ˢ Set.univ) →
                (∀ x ∈ U ×ˢ Set.univ, t.normal x ≠ 0) →
                  ∀ (k : NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Frequency) (frequency : ℝ),
                    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (NavierStokes.ParticularWaveBounds.complexCopyVelocity t f g hab k)
                        {p : P × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane | p.1 ∈ U ∧ (g.coordinates k p.2).2 ∈ Set.Icc a b} ∧
                      ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) (NavierStokes.ParticularWaveBounds.complexCopyPressure t f g hab k frequency)
                        {p : P × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane | p.1 ∈ U ∧ (g.coordinates k p.2).2 ∈ Set.Icc a b}

exact.text:
∀ {X : Type} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup X] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ X]
  (t : NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.TangentData (ℝ × X) NavierStokes.ProblemStatement.Space)
  (f : (ℝ × X) × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane → NavierStokes.HarmonicCalculus.ComplexVector)
  (g : NavierStokes.CommonCoverSolve.Geometry) {a b T : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b),
  0 < T →
    ∀ {W : Set X},
      IsOpen W →
        Convex ℝ W →
          ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) t.normal ((Set.Ico 0 T ×ˢ W) ×ˢ Set.univ) →
            ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) t.normalDot ((Set.Ico 0 T ×ˢ W) ×ˢ Set.univ) →
              ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) t.action ((Set.Ico 0 T ×ˢ W) ×ˢ Set.univ) →
                ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) t.damping ((Set.Ico 0 T ×ˢ W) ×ˢ Set.univ) →
                  ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) f ((Set.Ico 0 T ×ˢ W) ×ˢ Set.univ) →
                    (∀ x ∈ (Set.Ico 0 T ×ˢ W) ×ˢ Set.univ, t.normal x ≠ 0) →
                      ∀ {κ : NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane → ℝ},
                        ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) κ →
                          HasCompactSupport κ →
                            tsupport κ ⊆ Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ioo a b →
                              ∀ (frequency : ℝ) {C : Set (X × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane)},
                                IsCompact C →
                                  C ⊆ W ×ˢ Set.univ →
                                    ∀ (n : ℕ),
                                      TendstoUniformlyOn
                                          (fun (τ : ℝ) (z : X × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane) =>
                                            iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
                                              (NavierStokes.ParticularWaveBounds.commonVelocity t f g hab κ)
                                              ((τ, z.1), z.2))
                                          (fun (z : X × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane) =>
                                            iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n
                                              (NavierStokes.ParticularWaveBounds.commonVelocity t f g hab κ)
                                              ((Set.Ico 0 T ×ˢ W) ×ˢ Set.univ) ((0, z.1), z.2))
                                          (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) C ∧
                                        TendstoUniformlyOn
                                          (fun (τ : ℝ) (z : X × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane) =>
                                            iteratedFDeriv ℝ n
                                              (NavierStokes.ParticularWaveBounds.commonPressure t f g hab κ frequency)
                                              ((τ, z.1), z.2))
                                          (fun (z : X × NavierStokes.TorusInverse.Plane) =>
                                            iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ n
                                              (NavierStokes.ParticularWaveBounds.commonPressure t f g hab κ frequency)
                                              ((Set.Ico 0 T ×ˢ W) ×ˢ Set.univ) ((0, z.1), z.2))
                                          (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) C
